title: Catalogue
intro: A selection of our wines, chosen for their origin, their ageing and the patience with which they were made.
filter.label: Filter by type
wine.1.description: A red from Alella with a Mediterranean character. Ripe black fruit and wild-herb notes, with a short ageing in oak.
wine.2.description: Our flagship wine. Old-vine Grenache and Carignan from Priorat, with long barrel ageing. Deep, mineral and built to last.
wine.3.description: An elegant Penedès reserve, three years between barrel and bottle. Round, spiced and with a long finish.
wine.4.description: Pansa blanca, the historic grape of Alella. Fresh and saline, with a hint of sea breeze and white flowers.
wine.5.description: A barrel-fermented white from Penedès. Creamy, with stone fruit and a very fine toasty touch.
wine.6.description: A pale, gently pressed rosé from Alella. Delicate, with notes of strawberry and petals, ideal as an aperitif.
wine.7.description: A Gran Reserva cava with fine, creamy bubbles. Over thirty months of ageing, with notes of brioche and baked apple.
wine.8.description: Brut Nature Gran Reserva, with no added sugar. More than five years on the lees: complex, dry and with a very elegant bubble.
